data.summary: Growth-oriented Senior Business Analyst with 9+ years of experience across Capital Markets, Asset & Wealth Management, Investment Banking and data platforms, Proven expertise in end-to-end cloud and platform migrations, fund accounting, NAV calculation, trade lifecycle, and Trade Surveillance. Delivered 20+ BRDs and 80+ FSDs for global financial clients, led UAT for 5+ clients with >96% defect-free releases, and served as an onsite consultant in São Paulo spearheading Brazil market migration. Fluent in English and Portuguese; certified PSM & PSPO, Scrum practitioner.

Experience (São Paulo, Brazil) • PSM & PSPO Certified Capital Markets • Investment Banking • Asset & Wealth Management • FinTech & Data Analysis • ETL • Agile.SDLC Fund Accounting, Portfolio & Benchmark Performance • kallurig.isme1517@gmail.com • 8008890054/6302509675 • linkedin.com/in/guru-sai- krishna-kalluri
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Business Analyst – Capital markets Data Migration (ETL | Snowflake | Aladdin) Exafluence | Bengaluru, India
Dec 2025 – Present
Data platform modernization & Requirement Drafting: Leading end-to-end migration of data sets like portfolios, securities, Positions, NAVs from on-premises infrastructure to Snowflake by drafting detailed Jira user stories, data mapping sheets, acceptance criteria.
Cross-Cloud Pipeline Oversight: Assisting in daily GB-scale data transfers across cloud platforms, establishing data quality checks, ensuring SLA adherence and zero-downtime delivery for downstream financial reporting.
Aladdin Platform Operations & Data Analysis: Supporting data flows and resolving discrepancies by referring to Aladdin asset management platform to maintain accuracy of capital markets data including equity, bonds and Derivative instruments.
DBT Query Validation & Governance: Reviewing and validating DBT transformation queries authored by team members, enforcing data quality standards and preventing downstream errors in financial datasets.
Data Reconciliation via Ataccama: Executing systematic data reconciliation and quality checks to identify and resolve data mismatches between source and target environments across cloud migrations.
Team Leadership & Agile Delivery: Managing and mentoring a team of 8–15 developers, delivering technical guidance, performance insights, and workload prioritization in an agile environment.
Associate Product Analyst – Asset management & capital markets platform Multifonds | Bengaluru, India | São Paulo, Brazil (Onsite: Jul 2024 – Jun 2025)
Jan 2021 – Nov 2025
• Onsite Business Consultant – Brazil Market: Deployed to São Paulo as onsite consultant to lead migration of the
Brazil market, reporting structure onto the Multifonds platform. Collaborated with market experts, regulators, developers, and project managers to ensure compliant and timely project execution.
Platform Migration & Documentation: Drove migration of fund structures and capital market asset classes including Equities, Bonds, Corporate Actions, Derivatives, options, futures and FX instruments into Multifonds, authoring 20+ BRDs and 80+ FSDs over 4.8 years and providing detailed test case scenarios within the SDLC. • UAT Leadership & Quality Assurance: Spearheaded UAT for 5+ global clients, conducting regression, API, and
automation testing across 160+ test cases per client implementation, achieving >96% defect-free releases.
Client Enablement: Delivered client training sessions and authored comprehensive user guides to ensure seamless software adoption across global financial institutions.
Agile & Waterfall Delivery: Executed projects under both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, adapting to client requirements and regulatory constraints.
Emerging Lead – (Private equity | Trade life cycle |Trade Surveillance | SWIFT codes | OMS) State Street Corporation | Bengaluru, India
Aug 2018 – Dec 2020
Onshore-to-Offshore Migration: Led migration of complex operational procedures from onshore to offshore teams, ensuring seamless transition and continuity of critical financial operations.
Trade Lifecycle & OMS: Managed end-to-end trade lifecycle with hands-on experience in Order Management Systems (OMS) including Charles River, supporting order capture, compliance, execution, and settlement workflows.
SWIFT & Payments: Applied working knowledge of SWIFT payment messages (MT, PACS, CAMT) to support payment processing and cross-border settlement operations.
Cash & Reconciliation: Handled cash flows, ledger postings, and accounting flows, ensuring robust reconciliation and exception handling for trade settlements in compliance with global regulatory frameworks.
NAV Calculation & Recon Specialist - (Fund Accounting | Custody reconciliation |Asset servicing) BNP Paribas Asset Management | Chennai, India
Jan 2017 – Aug 2018
NAV Calculation & Fund Oversight: Served as SME for NAV calculation and reconciliation, overseeing daily valuation of 8+ daily, 10 weekly, and 5 monthly funds, ensuring timely and accurate processing across asset types.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Coordinated with Custody, Transfer Agency (TA), Pricing, and Corporate Actions teams to validate and justify all reconciliation breaks in TA, Cash, and Stock for each NAV cycle.
Corporate Actions & Fund Operations: Handled corporate actions for Equities and Bonds; processed ETF events, amortizations, management fees, and performance fees within fund structures.
Process Documentation & Knowledge Transfer: Contributed to Key/Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for processes migrated to Chennai, ensuring operational continuity and audit readiness.
International School of Management & Excellence, Bengaluru | 2015 – 2017
